_comment: The ILCE-1M2 firmware 4.00's hand tables: what the mapping found by hand about the camera and the rules the writer applies to its definition, the same for every owner of this model and firmware. kit/schema_update.py reads them (kit/writer/hand_tables.py); edit them here, by hand. How, when and from which state each hand fact was proved is the mapper's evidence, kept in the private overlay (private/evidence/ILCE-1M2_fw4.00.hand.json) and put back when the kit reads this file, never written here (docs/decisions/0016). A NEW_RECORDS entry {"$ref": "#/FILTER_FLAGS/<key>"} is FILTER_FLAGS' own entry. schemas/hand-tables.schema.json says what each table holds.
